description_en: Query webhook records configured on a code repository in batch, with support for paging
description_zh: 批量查询在代码仓库上配置的webhook记录，支持分页功能
name: ListRepositoryWebhook

parameters.help_en:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK+SK) or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization.
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。 
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en:
Page number.  
Default Value is 1, starting from page 1.
parameters.help_zh:
页码
默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en:
Page size.  
Default Value is 20. Valid range: [1, 100]
parameters.help_zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size
